name: WhisperX
tagline: Fast offline speech-to-text transcription with word-level timestamps and speaker diarization.
real_test_summary: Tested transcribing local audio files offline with batched processing and word-level timestamp alignment. Delivers accurate transcripts and subtitle timings without per-minute cloud transcription fees.
pros: Accurate word-level timestamps helpful for captions, subtitles, and editing
Batched local processing speeds up longer audio recordings
Runs offline with no cloud audio uploads or usage billing
cons: Requires Python environment setup and dependencies
Speaker labels may need extra model weights or tokens depending on setup
